title: Grade 4 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #2 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a typical feature of Mandirs? (1 mark)
   A. A bell rung gently on arrival
   B. A kitchen garden
   C. A roaring engine
   D. A water tank

2. Which is a bad habit during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Folding hands
   B. Sitting still
   C. Listening
   D. Laughing or talking

3. What does the veena stand for? (1 mark)
   A. War
   B. Music and the arts
   C. Wealth
   D. Rain

4. What is the garbhagriha? (1 mark)
   A. The inner room where the murti is placed
   B. The car park
   C. The kitchen
   D. The gate

5. What could you use to map the Mandirs in Kenya? (1 mark)
   A. A safe digital map with a teacher's help
   B. A dream
   C. A random guess
   D. A song

6. Which is polite when alighting? (1 mark)
   A. Leave rubbish
   B. Thank the driver or conductor
   C. Push others
   D. Run into the road

7. What should you do if you see something online that makes you uncomfortable? (1 mark)
   A. Put it back where you found it
   B. Tell a trusted adult
   C. Share it with friends
   D. Keep clicking

8. Which best describes a person with integrity? (1 mark)
   A. Honest even when nobody is watching
   B. Honest only when watched
   C. Loud
   D. Rich

9. Which faith's story in the lesson is about honest earnings? (1 mark)
   A. Jainism
   B. Buddhism
   C. Hinduism
   D. Sikhism

10. Which is fair play in a game? (1 mark)
   A. Following the rules even when nobody is looking
   B. Pushing
   C. Tripping others
   D. Cheating

11. What is the purpose of a lost and found corner? (1 mark)
   A. To keep found items until owners claim them
   B. To hide them
   C. To sell lost items
   D. To keep the items forever

12. Which is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Returning a lost item
   B. Doing your own homework
   C. Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   D. Owning up to a mistake

13. Which Jain teaching means not stealing? (1 mark)
   A. Ahimsa
   B. Satya
   C. Aparigraha
   D. Asteya

14. Which faith's story in the lesson is about truth and a king? (1 mark)
   A. Buddhism
   B. Hinduism
   C. Sikhism
   D. Jainism

15. How did the boy in the example story practise Asteya? (1 mark)
   A. He sold the purse
   B. He hid the purse
   C. He kept the money
   D. He found the owner of the purse

16. Which is a mistake in yoga practice? (1 mark)
   A. Comparing yourself with others
   B. Being calm
   C. Wearing loose clothes
   D. Following the teacher

17. How should the back be in Vajra Asana? (1 mark)
   A. Bent
   B. Straight
   C. Twisted
   D. Round

18. Why do children work in pairs in yoga? (1 mark)
   A. To copy
   B. To argue
   C. To race
   D. To check posture and encourage each other

19. In which year was International Yoga Day first celebrated? (1 mark)
   A. 2005
   B. 1990
   C. 2015
   D. 2030

20. Why should Kapaal Bhaati and Bhastrika be done gently by children? (1 mark)
   A. They are very slow
   B. They are painful always
   C. They are active and need care
   D. They cannot be done

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how to do Bhastrika. (3 marks)

22. Why should we breathe slowly during asanas? (2 marks)

23. Name two things a lost and found corner needs. (2 marks)

24. Explain how the four faiths in this lesson teach integrity. (5 marks)

25. Explain four things a passenger should do when alighting. (4 marks)

26. Give two benefits of daily prayer. (2 marks)

27. Explain what the white colour, the veena and the book stand for in the picture of Saraswati. (3 marks)

28. Describe how to set up a lost and found corner in a classroom. (4 marks)

29. State three rules of good behaviour when visiting a Mandir. (3 marks)

30. Give two signs of integrity. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — A bell rung gently on arrival
   The bell announces arrival.

2. D — Laughing or talking
   We should be quiet and respectful.

3. B — Music and the arts
   It is a musical instrument.

4. A — The inner room where the murti is placed
   It is the inner sanctum.

5. A — A safe digital map with a teacher's help
   We can use a map on a tablet.

6. B — Thank the driver or conductor
   Thanking shows good manners.

7. B — Tell a trusted adult
   A trusted adult can help.

8. A — Honest even when nobody is watching
   Integrity is honesty at all times.

9. D — Sikhism
   Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo.

10. A — Following the rules even when nobody is looking
   Fair play is integrity.

11. A — To keep found items until owners claim them
   Owners can claim their things.

12. C — Copying another person's work and calling it your own
   Copying and claiming it is cheating.

13. D — Asteya
   Asteya is non-stealing.

14. B — Hinduism
   The Harishchandra story.

15. D — He found the owner of the purse
   He returned it.

16. A — Comparing yourself with others
   Yoga is not a competition.

17. B — Straight
   A straight back is important.

18. D — To check posture and encourage each other
   Pairs encourage and help.

19. C — 2015
   It was first celebrated in 2015.

20. C — They are active and need care
   They are active exercises.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Sit tall, breathe in deeply through the nose, breathe out through the nose with the same force, repeat slowly a few times, and rest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sitting tall, 1 mark for equal in and out breaths, 1 mark for slow and rest.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps us calm and helps the body relax.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: A box or table for found items and a book to record the date and finder (any two sensible items).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hinduism: truth (Harishchandra). Sikhism: honest earnings (Guru Nanak and Bhai Lalo). Jainism: not stealing (Asteya). Buddhism: right speech and not stealing or lying.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each faith and 1 mark for a summary.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Wait for the vehicle to stop, take belongings, get off one at a time, look out for traffic, thank the driver (any four).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us start the day calmly, teaches discipline, makes us thankful and gives peace of mind (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: White stands for purity and peace, the veena stands for music and the arts, and the book stands for knowledge.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct meaning.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: Place a box or table in a safe place, write each item in a book with the date and finder's name, let owners claim their things, and thank those who return items.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for four points.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: Remove shoes, dress modestly, speak softly, switch off phones, do not touch the murti, ask before taking photographs (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: Telling the truth, keeping promises, returning what is not yours, not cheating (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.
